name: pigeon-skin-server
description: Cloudflare 原生的 Minecraft 皮肤站 —— Workers + D1 + R2 + Pages 完全重写版

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --env dev --workspace @pigeon-skin/server" "npm run dev --workspace @pigeon-skin/web"
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm exec --offline --workspace @pigeon-skin/server -- wrangler d1 migrations apply bs-dev --local --env dev --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:preview: npm exec --offline --workspace @pigeon-skin/server -- wrangler d1 migrations apply bs-preview --remote --env preview --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:prod: npm exec --offline --workspace @pigeon-skin/server -- wrangler d1 migrations apply bs-prod --remote --env production --config ../../wrangler.jsonc
